Hi, I'm Francisco Santiago Robles.

Economist based in Monterrey, Mexico. I work in corporate banking, I've loved sales since I was a kid, and I care a lot about giving back to my community.

My story

A bit of background

I grew up in Monterrey. I studied Economics at Universidad Regiomontana, and today I work at Banco Bancrea, in the leasing division, where I help manage a corporate leasing portfolio and support proposals for corporate clients from start to finish.

When I was 17, I spent time living in Lisbon and worked as a bartender. It was one of the first times I had to get things done in another language, with people from all kinds of backgrounds, and that stuck with me. Years later, in 2025, I had the chance to do a professional internship at Hotel Arts Barcelona, run by The Ritz‑Carlton, one of the most multicultural environments I've worked in. I audited income under Marriott International's standards and helped automate reporting for the team.

I've liked selling things since I was a kid. I started with a small business smoking dog bone treats, and later built ventures with small teams of my own.

I grew up in a family that always pushed us to support our community, and that stuck with me too. It's part of why I founded the IMEF Universitario chapter at my university, building its structure and its first relationships with faculty and finance professionals from scratch.

That same value is why I currently serve as Membership Development Director for Rotaract Club Monterrey Profesional.

These days I'm finishing my degree, working in banking, and looking for the next opportunity to keep combining what I enjoy most: selling, building teams, and understanding the numbers behind every decision. I'm not afraid of international moves, and I'd genuinely like to keep working across different countries.
